subjects.name: Arin
subjects.description: Man with dark curly hair and a beard, a red and navy plaid shirt, dark jeans, brown boots and a canvas satchel on his right shoulder

place.description: A sunlit stone courtyard: a pale plaster wall, a black iron railing on a low stone ledge in front of the wall, olive trees in terracotta pots, a worn stone floor.

shots.description: Arin keeps walking steadily across the sunlit stone courtyard, his canvas satchel on his right shoulder, his stride unbroken from the previous shot. The open courtyard fills the frame; the iron railing and the pale wall stand behind Arin. Sunlit stone paving underfoot. Side-view tracking shot at walking pace, held level with Arin. Camera position: In the open courtyard, level with him; the iron railing and the pale wall behind him.
shots.screen_direction: He walks from screen left to screen right.
shots.sound: Footsteps on stone, a light breeze in the olive leaves; the sound continues across the cut.

shots.description: Arin keeps walking steadily across the sunlit stone courtyard, his canvas satchel on his right shoulder, his stride unbroken. The iron railing crosses the lower foreground, slightly out of focus. Beyond it the open courtyard stretches to the far side, sunlit stone paving filling the midground and background. Arin is framed mid-shot, walking across the frame. Low-angle tracking shot from behind the railing, looking across the courtyard at Arin as he passes. Camera position: On the wall side of the courtyard, low and close to the railing; the railing in the near foreground, the open courtyard and its far edge behind him.
shots.screen_direction: He walks from screen right to screen left.
shots.sound: Footsteps on stone, a light breeze in the olive leaves; the sound continues across the cut.
